title: Qualified Accounts Weekly
summary: Turn a narrow ideal-customer profile into a small weekly account shortlist with structured firmographic evidence and timely reasons to act.
outcome: A ranked, evidence-backed answer to which accounts should be contacted this week, including fit reasons, disqualifiers, timely signals and next research steps.
boundary: The candidate does not find or verify people, send outreach, write to a CRM, promise an exact result count or treat a broad discovery result as a qualified shortlist.

catalog_tools.purpose: Discover company candidates from a natural-language ideal-customer profile.
Validate one shortlisted company's firmographic fit with structured evidence.
Add a bounded recent company signal when a timely reason to act is required.
Add labelled public context without replacing the structured company spine.

inputs: A narrow ideal-customer profile with geography, business type, size and exclusions
The business problem Scrollport or the seller can solve
A weekly shortlist size and definition of a timely reason to act
outputs: Accepted and rejected company candidates with fit reasons
Structured firmographic evidence for the shortlisted accounts
Ranked weekly account list with uncertainty and next-step labels

cost.model: Inspected per-call company discovery, enrichment and optional signal-research prices.
cost.notes: Draft rehearsal is limited to one discovery call and one company enrichment; publication requires a reliably bounded, relevant shortlist rather than one manually rescued result.

approvals: Approve the exact ideal-customer query, exclusions, planned enrichment count and maximum before research
Approve any additional enrichment, news or web-research call
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with the five public control tools
A local file or conversation state for the shortlist
